summary.text: Barbara Hernandez is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 50th District, serving since March 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Hernandez's legislature biography lists Hernandez as a former Kane County Board member and a member of the Aurora Township Youth Council.
It says Hernandez holds a bachelor's degree and a master's degree from Aurora University.
